name: 15-11-2026-test-brain-extraction
description: Wraps FSL bet with a fractional intensity threshold and optional robust centre estimation (-R) and bias field/neck clean-up (-B). This repository appears to be a test App: it has no main script or container, only run_bet.sh and brain_extract.py, which need FSL installed on the host.

inputs.description: Input T1-weighted NIfTI volume to skull-strip.

outputs.description: Brain-extracted (skull-stripped) T1w volume produced by FSL BET.

parameters.description: BET fractional intensity threshold (0–1). Lower values give a larger brain estimate.
Use BET's robust brain centre estimation (-R).
